subject: community-medicine
title: Cancer Screening in India: Oral, Breast and Cervical under NPCDCS

steps.title: Why these three cancers
steps.tx: **Oral, breast and cervical cancers** lead India's screenable burden and share programme-friendly traits: visible or palpable precancerous phases, cheap frontline tests deliverable by trained non-specialists, and curative early treatment. Health and wellness centres screen adults 30 years and above for exactly this trio under the national NCD programme's population-based screening arm.
steps.say: Three cancers fit community screening: mouth you can see, breast you can feel, cervix you can stain. Shared traits are visible precursors, cheap frontline tests and curative early treatment above age thirty.

steps.title: Oral cancer: tobacco writes the risk
steps.tx: **Oral screening** targets tobacco and areca nut users hardest: white patches that do not scrape off (leukoplakia), red velvety patches (erythroplakia, higher malignant potential), and stiffening submucous fibrosis limiting mouth opening. Any ulcer beyond 2 weeks, indurated patch or neck node in a chewer is referred, not watched, because Indian oral cancer presents late by habit.
steps.say: Chewers carry the risk. White un-scrapable patches, red velvety patches, stiffening mouths. Ulcers past two weeks in tobacco users get referred, never watched, because late presentation is the Indian pattern.

steps.tx: **Oral screening** focuses hardest on people who use tobacco or areca nut. Leukoplakia is a white patch that does not scrape off. Erythroplakia is a red velvety patch and carries higher malignant potential. Oral submucous fibrosis stiffens the mucosa and limits mouth opening. Any ulcer lasting beyond two weeks, any indurated patch, or a neck node in a chewer is referred rather than watched. Indian oral cancer still presents late because of the habit.
steps.say: Tobacco and areca users are screened for white patches that will not scrape off, red velvety patches, and mouths that stiffen. An ulcer past two weeks, a hard patch, or a neck node is referred at once. Late oral cancer is the usual Indian presentation.

steps.title: Breast: clinical examination and awareness
steps.tx: **Clinical breast examination** by trained workers finds lumps, skin dimpling, nipple retraction or discharge and axillary nodes, while breast self-awareness teaches women their normal so change gets reported early. Mammography serves diagnostic and high-risk roles rather than mass screening in Indian resource logic. Triple assessment (clinical, imaging, biopsy) settles referred lumps.
steps.say: Hands before machines here. Trained examination plus self-awareness finds change early; mammography serves diagnosis and high risk, not mass camps. Referred lumps settle by triple assessment.

steps.tx: At a cervical camp, 5 percent acetic acid is painted on the cervix and read after about one minute. **Visual inspection with acetic acid** produces an acetowhite patch on abnormal epithelium when the transformation zone is fully seen. Thermal ablation gear beside the couch allows an eligible lesion to be treated before the woman leaves. Mammography, by contrast, is kept for diagnosis and high risk rather than this style of mass camp.

steps.title: Cervical: VIA in one visit
steps.tx: **Visual inspection with acetic acid** whitens precancerous cervix for same-visit ablation (cryotherapy or thermal ablation) where protocols permit, collapsing screen-and-treat into one contact. HPV DNA testing is the more sensitive primary test entering programmes where laboratory logistics allow, with self-sampling extending reach. Cytology needs laboratories and repeat visits India historically struggled to complete.
steps.say: One visit can screen and treat. Acetic acid whitens precancer for same-day ablation; HPV DNA testing is entering where laboratories allow, even self-collected. Cytology's repeat visits historically leaked patients.

steps.title: HPV vaccination: primary prevention joins
steps.tx: **HPV vaccination** of girls 9 to 14 years prevents the infection behind most cervical cancer, complementing screening of older women who missed vaccine eras. Screening never retires after vaccination begins; cohorts age into risk for decades. The pair (vaccinate young, screen adults) is the elimination strategy's stated arithmetic toward incidence under 4 per 100000.
steps.say: Vaccinate the young, screen adults, for decades both. HPV vaccine at nine to fourteen prevents the cause; screening catches what vaccine eras missed. Elimination arithmetic needs the pair running together.

steps.title: Screening intervals and ages in programme wording
steps.tx: **Population-based screening** under NPCDCS covers adults 30 to 65 years at roughly 5-year intervals for the three cancers through HWCs and screening camps, with community-based assessment checklists (CBAC) scoring risk at household level first. Positive screens travel defined referral pathways to district diagnosis, because screening without assured diagnosis repeats the Wilson-Jungner violation.
steps.say: Thirty to sixty five, about five-yearly, household risk scored first. Positive screens travel assured referral pathways. Screening without guaranteed diagnosis violates the oldest screening criterion in the book.

steps.title: False reassurance and interval cancers
steps.tx: **Interval cancers** arising between negative screens expose test sensitivity limits and fast biology, so programmes audit them rather than hiding them. A negative screen is a risk reduction with an expiry date, counselled exactly that way. Overcalling benign findings floods biopsy services; undercalling forfeits the programme's moral contract with the screened.
steps.say: Negatives expire. Cancers between screens expose sensitivity limits and get audited openly. Counselled honestly, a negative is dated risk reduction. Flooding biopsies and missing cancers both break the contract.

steps.title: Tobacco control behind oral screening
steps.tx: **Tobacco control** (taxation, pack warnings, smoke-free laws under COTPA, cessation support) is oral cancer's primordial layer; screening without it mops a leaking tap. Gutkha bans by food safety route in states illustrate policy creativity examiners reward. Cessation brief advice at every NCD contact converts screening visits into prevention visits twice over.
steps.say: Screening mops; tobacco policy fixes the tap. Taxes, warnings, smoke-free law and cessation advice form the primordial layer. Every screening contact doubles as a cessation contact by design.

steps.title: Registry and survival monitoring
steps.tx: **Cancer registries** (population-based where functional) convert screening activity into incidence, stage-shift and survival evidence: successful programmes show stage migration toward early disease before mortality moves. Hospital registries alone flatter results by case mix. Stage at diagnosis is therefore the screening programme's first honest report card.
steps.say: Stage tells the truth first. Successful screening migrates diagnoses earlier before mortality budges. Population registries audit that shift; hospital series flatter by case mix. Demand stage data before celebration.
